hook: Gemini se ab Bhojpuri mein baat kar sakte ho.

beats.narration: Gemini se ab Bhojpuri mein baat kar sakte ho.
Google ke mutabik Gemini Live ab pachchees se zyada Indian bhashaon aur boliyon mein baat karta hai.
beats.claim: Gemini Live can converse in over 25 Indian languages and dialects.

beats.narration: Voice mein bhi, aur text mein bhi.
beats.claim: Support covers both voice and text.

beats.narration: List mein Sanskrit, Bhojpuri aur Maithili bhi hain.
beats.claim: Supported languages include Sanskrit, Bhojpuri and Maithili.

beats.narration: Matlab ghar ke bade bhi apni bhasha mein AI se sawaal pooch sakte hain.
Gemini app mein Live mode kholo aur apni bhasha mein bolna shuru karo.
Aap kaunsi bhasha mein try karoge? Comment mein batao.

title: Gemini se ab Bhojpuri mein baat kar sakte ho
